mapper.sql: select q.id, q.activity_id, q.token, q.action_type, q.expire_time, q.status, q.create_by, q.create_time, q.update_by, q.update_time, q.remark, a.title as activity_title, a.service_location from vol_activity_qr_token q left join vol_activity a on a.id = q.activity_id
mapper.select: where q.token = #{token} and q.status = 0 and q.expire_time >= now() limit 1
mapper.update: update vol_activity_qr_token set status = 1, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = now() where activity_id = #{activityId} and action_type = #{actionType} and status = 0
mapper.delete:
delete from vol_activity_qr_token where id in
#{id}
